displayName: OCI-LAT-CHN-022: Lateral movement chain — Brute Force → Account Takeover → Cloud Resource Access
description:
Detects brute force attack leading to account takeover and cloud resource access

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: lateral movement chain — brute force → account tak

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_lat_chn_022", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%lateral%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%movement%') AND "value" > 0
